about.en: NKN (New Kind of Network) is an open-source peer-to-peer network protocol that rewards nodes for relaying data, used for decentralized messaging, tunnelling and file transfer. The NKN token trades as the ERC-20 0x5cf04716ba20127f1e2297addcf4b5035000c9eb on Ethereum, which the project bridges to and from its own mainnet coin.
